approval.scope: explicit multi-OM device-state graph boundaries and exact device-side accept/commit

objective: strict-greedy batch-1 generation with persistent device state, no historical-prefix recompute, an exact selectable one-to-eight-transaction decode synchronization window, and an optional final-prefill/first-verify completion window

symbols.eos_table_width: fixed at export time and at least one

logical_roles.purpose: run the original ChunkGatedDeltaRule prefill path once over the prompt and produce the first clean anchor
required_outputs: projectable target features for real prompt rows

logical_roles.purpose: ordinary greedy and the exact zero-accept fallback without Draft execution

logical_roles.rows: dynamic Target-feature N=1..16 after verify, or N=64..kv_cache_max_len in 64-row prompt gears, plus a fixed anchor-and-15-mask proposal block
logical_roles.purpose: reuse committed Draft KV, append only newly committed Target features, and produce one fixed [anchor,p0..p14] verify carrier
required_outputs: fixed 16-row verify input IDs in a device-resident buffer

logical_roles.rows: fixed physical T=16: anchor plus 15 proposal rows; logical_proposal_count selects the exact prefix in 1..15
logical_roles.purpose: verify once, ignore the causal scratch suffix, compute the longest matching logical proposal prefix, select the committed Target state slot, and emit a compact transaction result
required_outputs: projectable features for anchor plus accepted proposals

target_persistent_state.name: target_conv_state
target_persistent_state.semantics: one committed scalar causal-conv window per linear-attention layer

target_persistent_state.name: target_recurrent_state
target_persistent_state.semantics: one committed recurrent state per linear-attention layer; ordinary FP16 results are widened after their existing FP16 boundary

target_persistent_state.name: target_key_cache
target_persistent_state.semantics: paged key cache grouped by full-attention layer

target_persistent_state.name: target_value_cache
target_persistent_state.semantics: paged value cache grouped by full-attention layer

target_persistent_state.name: logical_target_cursor
target_persistent_state.semantics: only positions below this cursor are committed; rejected physical KV slots may be overwritten

round_carriers.name: target_feature_tail
round_carriers.semantics: only committed_input_count leading rows are authoritative; fixed-16 is the rollback route and committed-prefix binds accepted_count+1 leading rows after a synchronized verify

round_carriers.name: committed_input_count
round_carriers.semantics: anchor plus accepted proposals, equal to accepted_count+1

tensor_abi.bank_policy: verify receives grouped committed scalar states, lets causal-conv consume its scalar state directly, seeds only the fixed 16-slot recurrent GDR-MTP input immediately before each linear-attention layer, gathers slot accepted_count at the exact tail, and persists only grouped scalar states

state_ownership.owner: one C++ request context with persistent device buffers
state_ownership.target_full_attention: provisional physical KV writes are allowed; only the logical cursor advances by anchor plus accepted proposals and rejected slots are overwritten later
state_ownership.target_gdr_and_conv: verify may materialize per-row banks as graph workspace, but its graph tail gathers slot a and persists only the selected scalar state
state_ownership.draft: only KV positions below logical_draft_cursor are authoritative; fixed-16 may write masked future feature slots as scratch, committed-prefix omits those writes, and either route overwrites a slot before it can become visible; the transient mask block is never committed
state_ownership.ordinary_decode_token: two compact result arenas ping-pong with the Target state index; the previous transaction's last committed token remains device-resident, row zero binds directly, and a later row is copied D2D into the existing aligned decode scalar
state_ownership.ordinary_decode_override: only a caller-supplied token that differs from the tracked last committed token uses the original pinned-host 8-byte H2D path

strict_greedy_transaction.accepted: largest a in [0,K] such that p[j] == t[j] for every j < a
strict_greedy_transaction.selected_target_state_slot: a because slot a is the state after anchor plus a accepted proposals
strict_greedy_transaction.all_match_commit: p[0:K] followed by t[K], unless an accepted proposal is EOS
strict_greedy_transaction.next_anchor: the correction t[a] or all-match bonus t[K]; it is emitted but not processed by Target until the next call
strict_greedy_transaction.eos: never emit a token after the first EOS
strict_greedy_transaction.fixed_physical_verify: the Target always executes 16 causal rows; logical_proposal_count and the first proposal EOS bound acceptance and state selection, and rows after that bound are scratch only
strict_greedy_transaction.causal_suffix_proof_obligation: for every Target layer, output/logit/feature/state slot i is independent of physical input rows j>i; promotion requires reduced-graph and real-model rejection tests

bytes_at_batch1_kv_max_len_2048_verify_t.notes: the JIT seed values describe source-graph input-seed tensors, not a measured OM peak; provisional output banks still exist; excludes model weights, model workspaces, I/O buffers, allocator/runtime overhead and optional feature/logit intermediates

draft_committed_prefix_work_model.classification: exact source-shape work lower bound; not measured Ascend310P latency
draft_committed_prefix_work_model.excluded_work: normalization, rotary, scatter/cache update, elementwise and compiler/runtime overhead, so this is not an end-to-end speedup estimate
draft_committed_prefix_work_model.measurement_gate: same Draft OM hash and runner binary; compare fixed-16 against committed-prefix with zero token/EOS mismatch, report physical Draft rows, then use unprofiled 3+10 latency for selection and msprof 1+1 only for diagnostic attribution

physical_oms: target-prefill-head split from the logical prefill role
target-verify-commit with a proven T=1 decode gear
physical_topology_candidates.source_evidence: torch.export T=1/2/7/16 and complete Fake ACL ordinary/DFlash state machine pass, including process-resident zero-count binding for every T=1 execution; real AIR/ATC/custom-op/parity/memory/latency pending
physical_topology_candidates.condition: custom operators, TorchAir and ATC preserve exact T=1 and T=2..16 gears in one Target step artifact
physical_topology_candidates.risk: Target weights may still exist in both prefill and verify artifacts

physical_topology_candidates.condition: static graphs outperform multi-gear and the summed queried/loaded weight memory fits the declared device budget
physical_topology_candidates.risk: three different Target artifacts can duplicate the 4B Target weights; four files alone do not imply speedup

physical_topology_candidates.condition: the different original-GDR and GDR-MTP branches compile, preserve custom nodes, pass parity, and beat static alternatives
physical_topology_candidates.risk: dynamic control/shape support and workspace inflation are unproven for the receiver custom operators

physical_oms: device-side Draft to Target verify/accept supergraph
physical_topology_candidates.condition: profile proves launch/host boundaries dominate and duplicated weights/workspace remain acceptable
physical_topology_candidates.risk: large graph compile risk and possible Target/Draft weight duplication

topology_selection_gates.serial_workspace_budget: maximum queried workSize when all resident models are proven to execute serially with one shared workspace
topology_selection_gates.weight_budget: sum queried weightSize; cross-artifact weight sharing must not be assumed
topology_selection_gates.state_budget: persistent state plus peak transient state/workspace plus I/O and a declared safety margin
topology_selection_gates.device_memory_allocation_policy: normal-only is the rollback default; huge-first is selected only by a same-source, same-OM, same-case, forward/reverse-order physical Ascend310P A/B whose runner reports record the compiled policy
topology_selection_gates.load_test: load the complete candidate set together on the exact 310P product before timing
topology_selection_gates.profile: unprofiled 3 warmups plus 10 measurements for promotion with execution tracing disabled; msprof profile 1+1 is diagnostic only and must pass complete model-ID/infer-ID/physical-row attribution plus exact runtime API count closure
topology_selection_gates.profile_analyzer: qwen35_dflash.ascend310p analyze-msprof rejects default partial exports, duplicate model/infer groups, missing Task Duration, role/gear count drift and aclmdlExecuteAsync/aclrtMemcpyAsync/aclrtMemsetAsync/aclrtSynchronizeStream count drift
topology_selection_gates.winner: lowest median end-to-end model-loop latency among zero-mismatch candidates, not the candidate with the most or fewest OM files

device_memory_allocation_policies.normal-only: default rollback binary; every explicit runner aclrtMalloc uses ACL_MEM_MALLOC_NORMAL_ONLY
device_memory_allocation_policies.huge-first: inactive exact build candidate; every explicit runner aclrtMalloc uses ACL_MEM_MALLOC_HUGE_FIRST, including per-artifact weights, the serial shared workspace, persistent state and carriers

hot_loop.device_memory_allocation_selection_gate: build two separate binaries from the same source revision, keep all OM hashes, runner options, prompt/token limits and target identity fixed, use forward/reverse-order runs (normal-only then huge-first, followed by huge-first then normal-only), require both reports to name their compiled policy and preserve zero token/EOS mismatch, reject either load failure or unsafe memory headroom, and select huge-first only when physical Ascend310P unprofiled 3+10 model-total median and p90 improve outside measurement noise; otherwise retain normal-only
hot_loop.stream: one request stream unless profile proves overlap safe and beneficial
hot_loop.draft_to_verify: the [anchor,p0..p14] carrier stays on device and binds directly to Target verify
hot_loop.draft_feature_dynamic_gears: one Draft OM contains verify-source N=1..16 plus prompt-source N=64,128,...,kv_cache_max_len; tensor order and weights are unchanged

draft_feature_policies.fixed-16: default rollback and matched baseline; every verify-source Draft execution binds N=16
draft_feature_policies.committed-prefix: inactive exact candidate; after a synchronized verify bind N=accepted_count+1, while each later unsynchronized transaction binds its predecessor's causal upper bound N=previous logical K+1

hot_loop.draft_feature_liveness_proof: only Draft KV positions below logical_draft_cursor are authoritative; fixed-16 suffix writes are masked scratch, and every omitted position is overwritten before the logical cursor can expose it
hot_loop.draft_feature_selection_gate: hold runner binary, all OM hashes, prompt/token limits, reset/decode/sync-window policies and device identity fixed; require zero token/EOS mismatch and closed row/route counters; select committed-prefix only when real 310P unprofiled 3+10 median and p90 improve outside measurement noise, otherwise retain fixed-16
hot_loop.last_committed_token_to_decode: the preceding compact Target result stays on device; row zero binds directly and later rows use one 8-byte D2D copy into the aligned decode scalar; no decode-ID H2D is issued by the standard scheduler
hot_loop.decode_fallback: an explicit caller override retains the exact 8-byte pinned-host H2D route

decode_carrier_policies.one-token-h2d: one-row compact Target results bind row zero directly; multi-token commits and explicit caller overrides use the pinned-host 8-byte H2D fallback
decode_carrier_policies.last-token-d2d: the last token from every compact Target result stays device-resident; row zero binds directly, later rows use one aligned 8-byte D2D compaction, and explicit caller overrides use pinned-host H2D

hot_loop.decode_carrier_selection_gate: compare both policies with the same runner binary, OM hashes, prompt/token limits, reset policy, device identity and alternating order; require zero token/EOS mismatch and unprofiled 3 warmups plus 10 measurements, then select last-token-d2d only when its median and p90 improve measurably; retain one-token-h2d when the result is a tie or within measurement noise; msprof is diagnostic only
hot_loop.rejected_unaligned_multi_row_binding: compact token rows 1 through 15 begin at 8-byte strides and cannot be bound directly as model inputs under the 64-byte AscendCL input-address rule; Fake ACL must reject that plan, so later rows use the aligned scalar D2D route
hot_loop.synchronization: default window 1 exposes one host-visible synchronization after each verify/commit; exact candidates 2..8 queue that many budget-safe dependent Draft-to-verify transactions; an independent exact prefill completion candidate queues final prefill plus first verify before one contiguous D2H and one stream synchronization

prefill_completion_policies.separate: default rollback baseline; final prefill compact result is downloaded and synchronized before the first verify
prefill_completion_policies.coalesce-first-verify: inactive exact candidate; when max_new_tokens is greater than two, final prefill and the already-prepared first verify share one contiguous compact D2H and one stream synchronization

hot_loop.prefill_first_verify_budget_guard: prefill commits one token and verify may commit K+1, so Draft is prepared only when max_new_tokens>2 and its K is min(max_draft,15,max_new_tokens-2); max_new_tokens=2 executes ordinary decode without a wasted Draft
hot_loop.prefill_first_verify_compact_download: the alternating compact slots share one contiguous arena; prefill slot 0 downloads slot_bytes+verify_bytes and pays slot_bytes-ordinary_bytes padding, while prefill slot 1 downloads slot_bytes+ordinary_bytes and pays slot_bytes-verify_bytes padding
hot_loop.prefill_first_verify_timing_scope: coalesce-first-verify delays first-token host visibility until verify completes, so prefill_ms/TTFT includes the first verify; compare model_total median/p90 and TTFT separately
hot_loop.prefill_first_verify_eos_policy: the first verify may already be queued when the prefill result is EOS; host commit stops at prefill EOS and ignores the verify result, preserving exact tokens with bounded useless device work
hot_loop.prefill_first_verify_selection_gate: hold runner binary, OM hashes, prompt, token limits and all other policies fixed; require zero token/EOS mismatch and closed counters, then select coalesce-first-verify only when real 310P unprofiled 3+10 model_total median/p90 improves and the delayed TTFT is acceptable; otherwise retain separate

dflash_sync_window_policies.1: default and rollback baseline; one speculative transaction per host-visible synchronization
dflash_sync_window_policies.2: inactive performance candidate; at most two complete speculative transactions use the existing compact ping-pong arenas and one host-visible synchronization
dflash_sync_window_policies.3..8: inactive exact performance candidates; every compact result is copied D2D from the two state-coupled ping-pong slots into an eight-slot staging arena, followed by one contiguous D2H and one host-visible synchronization

hot_loop.dflash_sync_window_budget_guard: starting from remaining, repeatedly choose Ki=min(max_draft,15,residual-1), reserve the worst-case Ki+1 commit, and stop at the requested window or residual<=1; every queued transaction therefore fits max_new_tokens even under full acceptance, and the final Ki may shrink
hot_loop.dflash_sync_window_proposal_count_stagin: eight dedicated 4-byte pinned-host scalar slots (32 bytes total) preserve asynchronous H2D source lifetime for every legal caller-supplied K sequence; the single device proposal-count carrier is updated in stream order before the corresponding Draft/verify execution
hot_loop.dflash_sync_window_compact_download: the two 64-byte-aligned state-coupled compact slots share one 1024-byte ping-pong arena; window 1 downloads one exact result and window 2 downloads 512+452=964 bytes directly, while windows 3..8 copy each 452-byte result D2D into a separate eight-slot 4096-byte device/pinned-host arena and issue one contiguous D2H with 60 padding bytes per elided result
hot_loop.dflash_sync_window_eos_policy: later transactions may already be queued when an earlier compact result reports EOS; host commit reads results in order, stops at the first EOS and ignores later results, so token IDs remain exact but rejection- or EOS-heavy requests may perform bounded useless device work that grows with the selected window
hot_loop.dflash_sync_window_selection_gate: hold runner binary, OM hashes, prompt, token limits, state reset, decode carrier, device identity and paired alternating order fixed; sweep 1,2,4,8 in forward and reverse order, require identical ordinary/DFlash token IDs and EOS, record adaptive-K transactions, physical rows, acceptance, H2D, D2H, D2D staging and barriers, and select a window above 1 only when real Ascend310P unprofiled 3+10 DFlash median and p90 improve outside measurement noise on representative length/acceptance/EOS cases; otherwise retain window 1
hot_loop.prefill: never execute Draft proposal or full LM head for non-final prompt chunks
hot_loop.prefill_control_prefix_policy: one aligned carrier uses exactly one H2D per chunk: base ends after IDs/effective length, count extends through the final-Draft cumulative prompt count, proposal extends through a changed proposal count, and full extends through the process-resident EOS table/count only on first use or EOS identity change
hot_loop.unified_target_step_zero_count_policy: T=1 datasets bind one process-resident 64-byte-aligned INT32 zero initialized by the first full prefill-control H2D; T=2..16 datasets bind the mutable positive-K proposal carrier, so ordinary decode performs no K=0 H2D and cannot force a later positive-K restore
hot_loop.profile_execution_trace_policy: profile 1+1 preallocates and records ordinal, runtime aclmdl model ID and physical T for every model execution; formal evidence 3+10 must report profile_model_execution_trace_enabled=false and an empty trace
hot_loop.verify: never recompute the committed historical prefix
runtime_counter_invariants: device_to_host_operations + speculative_d2h_operations_elided + prefill_verify_d2h_operations_elided == prefill_completion_synchronizations + target_decode1_executions + target_verify_commit_executions
draft_dynamic_gear_count == draft_verify_dynamic_gear_count + draft_prefill_dynamic_gear_count, with verify gears 16 and prefill gears kv_cache_max_len/64
compact_ping_pong_device_bytes and speculative_window_staging_device_bytes are positive and included in carrier_device_bytes
